newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 25.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- SITARAIL, company operating the Abidjan to Ouagadougou rail line, launches tender for 20 freight wagons (10 for Ivory Coast, 10 for Burkina Faso) for carrying quarrying produce; closing date for offers January 30; eligible suppliers -- from France, the CFA franc zone or countries where France's Caisse Francaise de Developpement operates

- Transport and transit company SAGA-CI announces that turnover rose 17.29 percent in six months from April to September 1996 - Lebanese-run SOCOCE company advertises that Abidjan's first hypermarket is now open; opening seven days a week 8 am.m. to 8 p.m.

- Ivorian coffee and cocoa planters unhappy with government about delays that put back the start of the 1996/97 cocoa and coffee marketing seasons; accuse upcountry buyers of taking advantage of their need for cash for school fees to buy at vastly knocked-down prices.
- Teachers in private, non-religious schools threaten strike over pay from December 16.
